name: windinput-comments-worker
description: 清风输入法文档站评论 Worker（D1 存储 + 服务端反垃圾 + Telegram 通知）

scripts.db:pending: wrangler d1 execute windinput-comments --remote --command="SELECT id, page_id, nick, substr(content,1,60) AS preview, created_at FROM comments WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:recent: wrangler d1 execute windinput-comments --remote --command="SELECT id, page_id, nick, status, substr(content,1,60) AS preview, created_at FROM comments ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:mode: wrangler d1 execute windinput-comments --remote --command="SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'moderation'"
